hard_blockers.detail: the v2.1 implementation identity hashes the schema and validators but does not bind the maker-engine or order-manager bytes that produce decision and lifecycle rows
enabling exact_opportunity_tape does not require the external venues, stablecoin bridge, source count, shadow-only mode, or formal destination contract
the exact tape uses the generic CSV writer, whose exceptions are logged and swallowed, with no producer-health identity or admission failure
orders without an originating exact decision context are skipped, so enabling the tape with inherited active orders creates an unmarked lifecycle hole
the REST reconcile path that restores an exchange-open PENDING_CANCEL order updates lifecycle state but does not emit the lifecycle callback consumed by the exact tape

the amendment names an ${NARROWGATE_PRIVATE_EVIDENCE_ROOT} authoritative destination, while runtime writes one append-only CSV path without per-day rotation, atomic manifest, hash admission, or a separate transfer contract

v2_2_minimum_contract: hash-bind every runtime producer and the exact deployment config
fail startup when source, bridge, shadow-only, destination, or schema dependencies are inconsistent
quarantine inherited orders until a complete new decision lineage begins
journal cancel rejection and every terminal branch exactly once
surface writer health and fail formal admission on any dropped or failed row
rotate bounded daily parts and atomically hash-admit them to the authoritative ${NARROWGATE_PRIVATE_EVIDENCE_ROOT} destination
run prospective zero-economic-row smoke collection before formal support counting
